# Combat in Quint handbook roadmap final report

This terminal report closes the parent-owned `$work-roadmap` reporting obligation for the
[Combat in Quint handbook roadmap](sir-combat-quint-handbook-roadmap.html). It is not a milestone,
semantic authority, or feedback cycle. It validates and summarizes the existing cycle evidence; the
handbook, literate Quint model, combat architecture, runtime registry, and prior feedback artifacts
retain their original authority boundaries.

## Exact coverage

- **Cycles:** 12
- **Checkpoint records:** 48
- **Roadmap milestones/operational units checked:** 10/10 (M0, M1, M2, M3, O1, M4, M5, M6, M6V, M7)
- **structured finding:** 5
- **positive pattern:** 23
- **accepted observation:** 16
- **deduplicated existing issue:** 4

Membership is derived from matching checkpoint streams and independently reconciled with schema-v2
report front matter. The counts above are results, not a hard-coded definition of completion. Each
cycle passed the existing checkpoint validator, exact report/actionability-audit validator, and
activation/binding validator. The two bounded repair cycles (CI handoff and Pages timeout) explicitly
exercise `implementation-test-evidence, verify-ship-pr`; the other ten exercise all four roadmap phases.

## Individual checkpoint dispositions

The immutable key is the full cycle id plus the one-based source JSONL line. “Rationale” is this
roll-up's judgement; summary and evidence are copied exactly and mechanically compared with the source.

- **`ci-handoff-repair#1` — deduplicated existing issue.** The first focused main run passed the documentation gate but reverified its pre-consumption producer receipt after the site was augmented, causing output-identity-drift; pr-verdict and protected-verdict still passed without the missing site handoff. Evidence: `run:EHotwagner/S.I.R#33093549465; issue:EHotwagner/S.I.R#368` Rationale: Existing S.I.R. issue #368 owned the missing protected handoff and delivered PR #369. Retained evidence: run:EHotwagner/S.I.R#33093549465; issue:EHotwagner/S.I.R#368
- **`ci-handoff-repair#2` — positive pattern.** A typed site handoff made the hosted failure reproducible as three local boundaries: final-site receipt freshness, archive identity, and protected-verdict ownership when documentation is selected. Evidence: `command:node scripts/test-qualified-site-handoff.mjs; command:node scripts/test-protected-stage-receipts.mjs; command:node scripts/test-pages-qualified-handoff.mjs` Rationale: Accepted from the implementation-test-evidence checkpoint; retained evidence: command:node scripts/test-qualified-site-handoff.mjs; command:node scripts/test-protected-stage-receipts.mjs; command:node scripts/test-pages-qualified-handoff.mjs
- **`ci-main-routing#1` — positive pattern.** The existing PR router already centralizes path classification, producer derivation, typed gate receipts, and deterministic joining, so main-push routing can extend one authority instead of creating a second taxonomy. Evidence: `file:scripts/ci-route.mjs; file:.github/workflows/ci.yml; issue:EHotwagner/S.I.R#366` Rationale: Accepted from the onboarding-first-build checkpoint; retained evidence: file:scripts/ci-route.mjs; file:.github/workflows/ci.yml; issue:EHotwagner/S.I.R#366

Evidence: `command:fsgg-sdd analyze --work 366-main-ci-routing --text; file:work/366-main-ci-routing/plan.md` Rationale: Accepted as a cycle-bounded friction after the bound schema-v2 audit; retained evidence: command:fsgg-sdd analyze --work 366-main-ci-routing --text; file:work/366-main-ci-routing/plan.md

## Fail-closed qualification

Run:

```sh
node work/382-handbook-roadmap-rollup/audit-roadmap-rollup.mjs
node work/382-handbook-roadmap-rollup/audit-roadmap-rollup.mjs --self-test
bash work/382-handbook-roadmap-rollup/qualify-roadmap-rollup.sh
```

The self-test isolates six defects: omitted cycle, omitted checkpoint, wrong report/audit binding,
count mismatch, invalid disposition, and unchecked milestone. Each must observe its named red before
the untouched repository restores green. The owner qualifier also reruns all three existing feedback
validators for every derived cycle and the strict documentation build.

## Maintenance conclusion

Future authority, model, runtime, vocabulary, visual, or toolchain changes follow the
[handbook maintenance checklist](rules/sir-combat-handbook-maintenance.html). This report is refreshed
only when the roadmap's completed-cycle evidence changes; refreshing it never creates a feedback cycle
for the refresh itself.
